title: Preserve keyboard focus when clearing the Test Runs session scope
outcome: Activating Show all runs clears the scope and moves focus to a stable surviving control so keyboard and screen-reader users can continue inspecting Test Runs.
acceptance: Activating Show all runs from keyboard clears the session scope, preserves View/Project/State, and leaves focus on an appropriate surviving control with the updated scope understandable.
A panel behavior test covers the focused clear action and its resulting rows and focus.
